BEFORE THE MISSOURI PUBLIC SERVICE COMMISSION
                       OF THE STATE OF MISSOURI
In the Matter of Union Electric Company              )
d/b/a Ameren Missouri’s Tariff to Adjust             )     ER-2026-0291
Its Revenues for Electric Service                    )


                      MIEC’S RESPONSE TO ORDER TO SHOW CAUSE

       COMES NOW the Missouri Industrial Energy Consumers (“MIEC”) and pursuant to the

Commission’s November 10th Order in this case, responds as follows:

       1. On July 16, 2026, the MIEC filed its application to intervene in this case. No party

          objected to this application, and the Commission granted the MIEC’s application on

          July 30, 2026. In the months since MIEC’s application was granted, the MIEC has

          been an active participant in this case.

       2. On July 20, 2026, the MIEC initiated the process to update its corporate filings with

          the Missouri Secretary of State.

       3. Good cause exists for MIEC’s intervenor status because the MIEC is a now a

          Missouri Nonprofit Corporation in Good Standing.


       WHEREFORE, the MIEC respectfully requests that the Commission find that the MIEC
has shown cause as required by the Commission’s Order.
                                              Respectfully submitted,
                                             /s/ Diana M. Plescia
                                             Missouri Bar #42419
                                             7733 Forsyth, Suite 1100
                                             Clayton, Missouri 63105
                                             Telephone (314) 704-8444
                                             dianaplescia@dmpfirm.com




                              CERTIFICATE OF SERVICE
     I hereby certify that a copy of the foregoing has been served to all parties on the
Commission’s service list.
                                             /s/ Diana M. Plescia
